info.title: PromptIQ API
info.description:
Universal Prompt Intelligence, Project Engineering, and Cross-Agent Continuity Platform.

**Strict Invariants**:
- Zero-price to end-users (₹0)
- Strictly No BYOK / No user API keys
- No local inference required
- Canonical versioned Project Constitution
- Website frontend strictly out of scope
